subject: Request: trial credits & bookkeeping guidance for BrightLane PoC
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlane.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension + promo credit to cover PoC overages

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the smooth PoC kickoff this week — the team is impressed with the latency numbers. We did hit a usage spike during volume tests and we’re likely to exceed the credits in our trial before the end of July.

Can Redwood provide a $10,000 promotional credit or extend the trial window through Aug 31 while we finalize procurement? We’d like to avoid an unexpected invoice while buyers complete PO routing. Attached the SOW and a short note about expected volumes.

If there’s an approval form to fill or a preferred accounting route (credit memo vs invoice hold), loop me in and I’ll get Jason (our finance lead) to provide the PO reference.

Appreciate the help — Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of AI Strategy, BrightLane AI
elena.rossi@brightlane.ai
+1 415-555-0198
Attachment: BrightLane_SOW_Q3.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlane.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + promo credit to cover PoC overages

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the SOW. Happy to help.

A couple quick items so we can move this to accounting:
- Proposed promotional credit: $10,000 (to clear expected overage).
- Target accounting treatment: apply as an invoice offset to INV-20250701, or if no open invoice, issue a credit memo to be applied to the next invoice.
- Customer PO: can you share Jason's PO number when available? That will speed routing.

Markus / Rishi — can Finance confirm preferred approach here? If acceptable, I’ll fill the promo approval doc (attached) and provide the PO. We’ll need the GL/ledger routing (contra-revenue vs marketing expense) so CS and RevOps are aligned.

Next steps: Elena — I’ll wait for Jason’s PO and then route to finance for final sign-off.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0122
Attachment: promo_approval_request.docx

Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + promo credit to cover PoC overages

Neha / Rishi —

Thanks for the heads up. High-level guidance from Accounting:

1) If there is an outstanding invoice (INV-20250701) that BrightLane has not yet paid, we should issue a credit memo for $10,000 and apply it against that invoice. That clears the receivable cleanly.

2) If there is no open invoice, we can still issue a credit memo which the AR team will hold as a credit on the customer account to be applied to the next invoice.

3) Revenue/ledger treatment: promotional credits must be booked as contra-revenue (account code 4205) — not as marketing expense — per our revenue recognition policy. Tax impact varies by jurisdiction; for US customers we typically net contra-revenue.

4) Required fields for processing: customer legal name, customer billing address, customer PO (if any), invoice number to offset (if applicable), and internal approval form (promo_approval_request). I’ve attached the standard credit_memo_template.xlsx — populate all fields and route to accounting@redwood.com.

5) Approvals: I can approve up to $15k for promotions. This $10k is within threshold — considered approved pending completed template and PO.

Please confirm once you have the PO and I’ll mark this as approved for accounting to create the credit memo.

-Markus

--
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0180
